title: Difference of Squares (JavaScript)
prompt:
In this project directory, implement a Node.js CommonJS module named difference_of_squares.js exporting two functions via module.exports = { squareOfSum, sumOfSquares }:
  - squareOfSum(n) : returns the square of the sum of the first n positive integers (1..n).
  - sumOfSquares(n) : returns the sum of the squares of the first n positive integers (1..n).
There is already a hidden reference test suite at tests/test_difference_of_squares.test.js (uses Node's built-in node:test + node:assert, no npm install needed) -- do NOT modify it. Your Testing phase should run `node --test tests/*.test.js` from the project root (in addition to any tests you write yourself) and every test must pass. Also add a short README.md explaining the two functions.
